display.label: AWS SQS Queue
display.description: Provision Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) standard and FIFO message queues with SSE-SQS / KMS encryption and redrive policies

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier name for the SQS queue. Serves as map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Queue name, FIFO settings, and message deduplication scopes.

fields.label: Queue Name
fields.description: The name of the SQS queue. For FIFO queues, the name must end with '.fifo'.

validation.pattern_error: Queue name must be 1-80 characters (letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores); FIFO queue names must end with exactly '.fifo' and contain no other periods.

fields.label: Name Prefix
fields.description: Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with name.

validation.pattern_error: Name prefix may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

fields.label: FIFO Queue
fields.description: Designates whether the queue is FIFO. If true, name must end with '.fifo'.

fields.label: Content-Based Deduplication
fields.description: Enables content-based message deduplication for FIFO queues.

fields.label: Deduplication Scope
fields.description: Specifies whether message deduplication occurs at message group or queue level.

fields.label: FIFO Throughput Limit
fields.description: Specifies whether FIFO queue throughput quota applies to entire queue or per message group.

sections.label: Message Timing & Retention
sections.description: Timeouts, retention periods, delay settings, and long polling.

fields.label: Visibility Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: The visibility timeout for the queue in seconds (0 to 43200).

fields.label: Message Retention (seconds)
fields.description: Number of seconds Amazon SQS retains a message (60 to 1209600).

fields.label: Max Message Size (bytes)
fields.description: Limit in bytes before SQS rejects a message (1024 to 262144).

fields.label: Delivery Delay (seconds)
fields.description: Time in seconds that delivery of messages is delayed (0 to 900).

fields.label: Receive Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Time in seconds that ReceiveMessage waits for messages (long polling, 0 to 20).

sections.label: Encryption & Access Policies
sections.description: SSE-SQS / KMS server-side encryption and IAM queue policies.

fields.label: Enable SQS-Managed SSE
fields.description: Enable server-side encryption with SQS-owned encryption keys (SSE-SQS).

fields.label: KMS Master Key ID
fields.description: KMS CMK ID, ARN, or alias (e.g. alias/aws/sqs) for custom encryption.

fields.label: KMS Data Key Reuse (seconds)
fields.description: Time in seconds Amazon SQS can reuse a data key (60 to 86400).

fields.label: Queue IAM Policy
fields.description: IAM resource policy for the queue as a JSON string.

sections.label: Dead Letter Queue & Redrive
sections.description: Redrive policy and DLQ routing permissions.

fields.label: Redrive Policy (JSON)
fields.description: JSON string containing deadLetterTargetArn and maxReceiveCount.

fields.label: Redrive Allow Policy (JSON)
fields.description: JSON string specifying which source queues can use this queue as a DLQ.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags assigned to the SQS queue.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the queue.
